title: Exclusion-ratio audit of every signed card reachable from the live site
question_put_to_the_board: At what exclusion ratio does a card stop being a measurement? Today a card published MEASURED with n=77 and 122 parse errors excluded (61% of attempts discarded); another with 95% discarded is UNMEASURED. Is the threshold consistent, inconsistent, or absent?

walk.completeness: COMPLETE: all 800 unique card URLs named by the two root indexes were fetched and parsed; 0 unreachable, 0 unparseable.
walk.not_walked: public/interop/pod-cards-index.json reports signed_files_seen=2377 and skipped_non_pod_or_unreadable=1912 at build time. Those 1912 files are NOT in either root index and were NOT fetched here. This audit covers the cards the two live indexes name, not every signed file on disk.

derivation_rule.attempted: n + parse_errors_excluded + transport_errors_excluded — derived here only when ALL THREE are integers on the signed bytes; otherwise null.
derivation_rule.exclusion_ratio: (attempted - n) / attempted; null when attempted is null or 0.
derivation_rule.zero_is_not_absent: A card publishing parse_errors_excluded: 0 excluded nothing. A card publishing no such field gets null and the state EXCLUSIONS_ABSENT — never 0.
derivation_rule.source_of_vocabulary: functions/_lib/denominator.ts (readDenominator) — this audit uses the same arithmetic.

code_predicate_governing_status.finding: NO exclusion-ratio predicate exists anywhere in the producers. Card body status is decided on the graded count alone.

where_n_comes_from.note: body.n is graded_n — already NET of every exclusion. By the time the signer sees n, the discarded attempts are invisible to it. The signer cannot apply a ratio rule because it is not given the denominator.

code_predicate_governing_status.searched_and_absent: grep across scripts/, harness/, gpu-offload/, functions/ for any comparison of an exclusion count, an exclusion ratio, or attempted against a threshold returns nothing. functions/_lib/denominator.ts READS and PUBLISHES the ratio's components but asserts no threshold and gates nothing.

distribution.band_definition: 0% = exactly zero excluded; then half-open upper-inclusive bands on excluded/attempted; >75% is strictly above 0.75.

summary_over_cards_with_a_computable_rat.overlap_of_the_two_status_ranges: The MEASURED and UNMEASURED ratio ranges overlap across the whole scale. Ratio does not separate them; n does.

verdict_on_the_threshold: ABSENT. There is no exclusion-ratio threshold in the code and none implied by the corpus. status is a function of graded n alone (n>=30). The 61%-excluded MEASURED card and the 95%-excluded UNMEASURED card are BOTH correct outputs of that one rule: the first graded 77 items, the second graded 2. The apparent inconsistency is a ratio rule the board has never made, not a ratio rule applied unevenly.

corpus_3_cards_carry_no_status_at_all.finding: These bodies have no `status` field and no `compute_evidence`. They are an earlier card generation (public_framing: "13 measured of 14 quotable", preimage_rule stated as a Python expression). They are therefore neither MEASURED nor UNMEASURED by their own bytes, and no exclusion ratio can be derived for any of them. They appear in the cross-tab as STATUS_ABSENT / NOT_APPLICABLE_EXCLUSIONS_ABSENT — never as zero-exclusion cards.
corpus_3_cards_carry_no_status_at_all.consequence_for_the_board: The standing "335/335 verify" figure is about SIGNATURES. It is not 335 cards asserting MEASURED. Any threshold rule the board writes must say what it does with a body that states no status.

seventy_pod_cards_publish_only_one_of_th.direction: ALL 70 publish transport_errors_excluded and omit parse_errors_excluded. The reverse never occurs.
seventy_pod_cards_publish_only_one_of_th.finding: For these cards `attempted` cannot be completed from the signed bytes, so the exclusion ratio is null — not zero. A ratio threshold would be unenforceable against them without a re-run, because the missing count is not recoverable from the card.

axis_concentration_of_high_exclusion.note: Which axes the exclusions land on. Counted only over cards with a computable ratio.

what_this_is_not: NOT a re-grading. No card's status was changed, no signed bytes were edited, no card was re-signed. Every status reported here is the status the signed body carries.

NOT a verification. Signatures were NOT checked in this walk. A row here says what the bytes claim, not that the bytes are authentic. Use scripts/verify_card.py (verify_signed_card_with_did_doc) plus a failing control for that.

NOT a census of every signed card in the estate. It is the 800 unique cards the two live indexes name. pod-cards-index.json itself reports 1912 further signed files skipped at build time as non-pod or unreadable; they were not fetched and nothing here describes them.
NOT a claim that a low exclusion ratio makes a card good, or a high one makes it bad. The audit measures the ratio and reports the rule; it asserts no quality judgement about any card.
NOT a board ruling. It is the data a ruling would stand on. The threshold question is open.

NOT zero-filled. A card that publishes no exclusion counts has null, attempted null, ratio null and the state EXCLUSIONS_ABSENT. It is not counted as a card with zero exclusions and is excluded from every band in the cross-tab under a NOT_APPLICABLE column.

NOT a statement that the three card corpora were added together. Cards reachable from both indexes are counted ONCE by URL; the overlap is reported. See council-os/CARD-CORPORA.md before quoting any card number from this file.
